info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

post.description: Create a single order with side, type, quantity, and optional price fields. Supports optional client order IDs and attached risk instructions (take-profit, stop-loss, trailing stop).
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Create up to 20 orders in a single request with accepted or rejected outcomes for each item. Supports mixed symbols and attached risk payloads.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Cancel a single open order by order ID or client order ID. Supports optional subaccount and symbol scoping.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Cancel all matching open orders for an account. Supports optional symbol and side filters plus dry-run preview.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Set or disable a dead-man switch timeout for automatic cancel-all. Supports optional symbol and side scope with idempotent heartbeat refresh.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Cancel up to 50 orders by order ID or client order ID in one request. Returns per-item accept or reject results with aggregate counts.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Modify a single open order by order ID or client order ID. Supports amend-or-replace behavior policies, price and quantity updates, and attached risk updates.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Check current order eligibility and available balance, and preview resolved quantity, price protection, quote debit, and fees. The result is advisory.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Replace up to 50 orders for one symbol and return an admission receipt for status and private realtime reconciliation.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
